ExchangeType.description:
Structure of a distressed exchange offer.

The variant records how the new instrument ranks against the existing claim
and is reported back on [`ExchangeOfferAnalysis`] for audit purposes; it
does not change the arithmetic.

oneOf.description: New instrument issued at the same face amount as the old claim.
New instrument issued at a face amount below the old claim.
Participating creditors are lifted above the existing capital structure.
Participating creditors are subordinated relative to their old claim.

description: Terms of a distressed exchange offer, from the creditor's side.

consent_fee.description:
Cash consent or early-tender fee paid to participating holders;
non-negative.

equity_sweetener_value.description:
Estimated value of equity or warrants attached to the new instrument;
non-negative.

exchange_type.description: Structure of the offer, echoed onto the result.

new_pv.description:
Present value of the new instrument received on tendering;
non-negative.

old_pv.description:
Present value of the existing claim if it is not tendered;
non-negative.
